budget_discussion: LogisticRegression: 2-param search space, cheap fit (<1s/fold) -> 30 trials, no pruning needed, 51s total. XGBoost: 9-param search space, ~5x more expensive per fit -> capped at 40 trials / 900s timeout with MedianPruner reporting per-fold PR-AUC so trials clearly worse than the running median after fold 1 are killed early (19/40 trials pruned), reallocating budget to promising regions instead of finishing every trial to completion.
